titles.title: Trees

description: An abstract cluster of trees with slender trunks floating on a mound, painted in dazzling gradations of transparent blacks, grays and puffs of blue and red, framed by an arched halo of brilliants blues.  Trees, appears to be painted using a mixture of Prussian Blue and carbon black with some lead chromate yellow in the greener tones and vermillion reds. Colors  bleed into one another, producing mottled surfaces and intense variations of tone.
title: Trees
